title: Scaffold Daily Inspection Checklist PDF, Printable Scaffold Safety Log, Competent Person Form, Construction Safety Template
description:
SCAFFOLD DAILY INSPECTION CHECKLIST (PRINTABLE PDF)

A clear, ready-to-print checklist for the competent person to inspect a scaffold before every work shift, plus a log sheet to keep the record on file.

WHAT YOU GET
- Page 1: Scaffold daily inspection checklist (17 checks)
- Page 2: Scaffold inspection log (multi-day record)
- 1 PDF file, US Letter (8.5 x 11 in), instant download

WHAT THE CHECKLIST COVERS
A. Foundation and structure: base plates, plumb frames, pins and braces, tie-ins, mobile scaffold casters
B. Platforms and guardrails: planking, gaps, overhang, top rail and midrail, toeboards, fall protection
C. Access, hazards and use: safe access, power line clearance, load, weather, scaffold tag

Also included: Pass / Fail / N/A boxes with a notes line, green tag / red tag result, corrective action lines and signature lines for the competent person and the supervisor.

HOW TO USE
1. Download the PDF after purchase.
2. Print as many copies as you need on US Letter paper.
3. Inspect before each shift, mark each item, sign and tag the scaffold.
4. Record the result on the log sheet and keep it on file.

IMPORTANT
This is an inspection aid only. It is not legal advice and does not replace your local regulations, the scaffold manufacturer's instructions or your site safety plan. Requirements vary by country and state. The checklist is built around common U.S. practice (for example OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart L), but you are responsible for meeting the rules that apply to your site.

DIGITAL PRODUCT
No physical item will be shipped. Because this is an instant digital download, refunds are not available, but if you have any problem with the file just message me and I will help.

title: Harness and Lanyard Inspection Checklist PDF, Fall Protection Inspection Log, Printable Safety Harness Form, Construction Safety
description:
HARNESS AND LANYARD INSPECTION CHECKLIST (PRINTABLE PDF)

A simple pre-use inspection checklist for full-body harnesses, lanyards, shock absorbers and self-retracting lifelines, plus a weekly inspection log for every worker.

WHAT YOU GET
- Page 1: Harness and lanyard pre-use inspection checklist (17 checks)
- Page 2: Weekly harness and lanyard inspection log
- 1 PDF file, US Letter (8.5 x 11 in), instant download

WHAT THE CHECKLIST COVERS
A. Harness: webbing, stitching, D-rings, buckles and adjusters, straps and loops, impact indicators, labels, fit
B. Lanyard / shock absorber / SRL: webbing or rope, shock absorber pack, snap hooks and carabiners, connectors, self-retracting lifeline, total length and fall distance
C. Anchorage and work area: anchor point rating and condition, rescue plan

Also included: Pass / Fail / N/A boxes with a notes line, "safe to use" or "removed from service" result, corrective action lines and signature lines for the inspector and the supervisor.

HOW TO USE
1. Download the PDF after purchase.
2. Print as many copies as you need on US Letter paper.
3. Check the gear before each use. Remove any item that fails from service and tag it.
4. Record the weekly review on the log sheet and keep it on file.

IMPORTANT
This is an inspection aid only. It is not legal advice and does not replace your local regulations, the equipment manufacturer's instructions or your site safety plan. Requirements vary by country and state. The checklist reflects common U.S. practice (for example OSHA 29 CFR 1926.502), but you are responsible for meeting the rules that apply to you.
